title: Autodesk
description: Autodesk's official brand system defines the primary colours Autodesk Black (#000000), Autodesk White (#FFFFFF) and Hello Yellow (#FFFF00), the secondary colours Warm Slate (#D5D5CB) and Slate (#666666), and the tertiary colours Dawn (#F09D4F), Dusk (#F2520A), Twilight (#1D91D0) and Morning (#2AD0A9).
